subject: reasoning
question:
Satheesh starts from his home and drives 5 km towards north. He then takes a left turn, drives 6 km, turns left, and drives 4 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 5 km and turns right, then drives 3 km to reach his office. In which direction is the office with respect to his home?

(Note: All turns are 90° turns only, unless specified.)
solution:
• Satheesh starts from his home and drives 5 km towards north.
 
• He then takes a left turn, drives 6 km, turns left, and drives 4 km.
 
• He then takes a right turn and drives 5 km and turns right, then drives 3 km to reach his office.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7220b3a1585d624a3fc81928ccfb0885d4c8246f779c29c5898e7fb3fa1e8c68.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**
